name: Classic Black Hoodie
description: A mid-weight unisex hoodie with rib-knit cuffs and kangaroo pocket, perfect for cool evenings. Made from premium cotton-polyester blend for durability and comfort. Features drawstring hood and spacious front pocket for essentials.

name: Sunset Graphic Tee
description: Eye-catching graphic t-shirt featuring a vibrant sunset design that captures the essence of summer adventures. Soft ring-spun cotton construction ensures all-day comfort. Perfect for music festivals, beach days, or casual hangouts with friends.

name: Ocean Breeze Shorts
description: Lightweight performance shorts designed for active lifestyles and water activities. Quick-dry fabric technology keeps you comfortable during intense workouts or beach volleyball sessions. Elastic waistband with drawstring for perfect fit adjustment.

name: Forest Green Jacket
description: Versatile outdoor jacket built for trail adventures and urban exploration. Weather-resistant shell protects against light rain and wind. Multiple zippered pockets provide secure storage for hiking essentials and everyday carry items.

name: Monochrome Sneakers
description: Minimalist sneakers that seamlessly blend comfort with contemporary style. Premium leather upper paired with cushioned sole for all-day wear. Versatile black and white colorway complements both athletic and casual outfits effortlessly.

name: Crimson Running Cap
description: High-performance running cap engineered for serious athletes and weekend warriors. Moisture-wicking sweatband keeps perspiration at bay during intense training sessions. Reflective details enhance visibility during early morning or evening runs.

name: Pastel Yellow Hoodie
description: Soft fleece hoodie in a cheerful pastel yellow that brightens any wardrobe. Oversized fit provides cozy comfort for lounging at home or casual outings. Kangaroo pocket and adjustable hood make it both functional and fashionable.

name: Midnight Blue Joggers
description: Premium joggers crafted for ultimate comfort and style versatility. Tapered fit with ribbed cuffs creates a modern silhouette perfect for gym sessions or casual meetups. Soft inner fleece lining provides warmth without bulk.

name: Charcoal Beanie
description: Classic knit beanie that delivers warmth and style during colder months. Soft acrylic yarn construction feels gentle against skin while providing excellent insulation. Foldable cuff allows for versatile styling options and perfect fit adjustment.

name: Rose Pink Sweatshirt
description: Cozy pullover sweatshirt in a beautiful rose pink shade that adds feminine flair to casual ensembles. Soft cotton blend fabric ensures comfort during all-day wear. Relaxed fit and crew neckline create an effortlessly chic look.

name: Lime Sport Socks
description: High-performance athletic socks designed for runners and fitness enthusiasts. Moisture-wicking synthetic blend keeps feet dry during intense workouts. Cushioned heel and toe areas provide extra comfort and durability for long training sessions.

name: Slate Tech Gloves
description: Touchscreen-compatible gloves that keep hands warm while maintaining full smartphone functionality. Conductive fingertips allow seamless device interaction without removing gloves. Sleek design works perfectly for commuting and outdoor activities.

name: Ivory Summer Dress
description: Elegant flowing dress perfect for warm weather occasions and special events. Lightweight breathable fabric drapes beautifully and moves gracefully with every step. Versatile ivory color pairs easily with accessories for both day and evening looks.

name: Amber Hiking Backpack
description: Durable expedition backpack built for serious outdoor adventures and multi-day hiking trips. Multiple compartments and external attachment points organize gear efficiently. Padded shoulder straps and back panel ensure comfortable carrying even with heavy loads.

name: Ebony Leather Belt
description: Premium genuine leather belt that adds sophistication to both casual and formal attire. Hand-crafted construction ensures long-lasting durability and develops beautiful patina over time. Classic buckle design complements any wardrobe style perfectly.
